title: The absentminded beggar,
html_source:
The Absent minded beggar , a poem by Rudyard Kipling which was used to raise money for the Boer war when put to music by Sir Arthur Sullivan

http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=oozEox5SttI

The Boer War then triggers more thoughts in Stephen in three lines time.
